selection.ownership: Bannerbear is an international image-generation API operated by founder Jon Yongfook (Singapore). Singapore is not mainland China. The reviewed edition is the global V2 REST API at api.bannerbear.com.

research.searchCoverage: Official Bannerbear V2 REST authentication (Authorization Bearer project or master API key), GET /v2/auth, GET /v2/templates, GET /v2/templates/:uid, GET /v2/images/:uid, api.bannerbear.com host, founder/operator identity, and dated incident search (Bannerbear + security breach/incident) reviewed on 2026-09-13. No qualifying current unresolved Bannerbear customer-data compromise was identified in reviewed coverage; this is not a breach-free claim.

Official Bannerbear V2 documents Bearer API keys on https://api.bannerbear.com. GET /v2/auth, templates, and images confirmed on 2026-09-13. Operator is the international Bannerbear product (founder based in Singapore). Dated incident search found no qualifying unresolved Bannerbear platform compromise. Banner Capital Bank and BigBear phishing reports are different entities.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to GET /v2/auth, the same cheap authenticated read used by the pinned credential validator. Image create (including sync.api.bannerbear.com) is omitted as a write/billable render.
Optional project_id for Full Access Master keys is omitted; this recipe uses a project-scoped API key.
V5 API keys and endpoints are not expressed: pinned source is V2.
The upstream user-agent is not sent.
Native category is utility rather than Design & Media/Marketing: Rust CATEGORIES has no marketing bucket; admitted ops are catalog reads, not campaign management.
Returns the raw Bannerbear JSON array under data instead of the upstream {templates} wrapper.
Optional page, limit, tag, name, extended, and project_id query parameters are omitted.
The upstream user-agent is not sent.
uid is a URL-encoded path segment on GET /v2/templates/{uid}.
Returns raw Bannerbear JSON under data instead of the upstream {template} wrapper.
Optional extended and project_id query parameters are omitted.
The upstream user-agent is not sent.
uid is a URL-encoded path segment on GET /v2/images/{uid}.
Returns raw Bannerbear JSON under data instead of the upstream {image} wrapper.
Optional project_id query is omitted.
The upstream user-agent is not sent.
GET /v2/account returns quota and current project usage under data.
POST /v2/templates creates a blank template; tags are omitted.
PATCH /v2/templates/{uid} updates name/metadata.
DELETE /v2/templates/{uid} is mapped as destructive; response is a deleted flag.
GET /v2/images returns a JSON array under data. Optional page and limit are expressed.
POST /v2/images queues an async render and accepts 202. Sync host is not used.
GET /v2/videos returns a JSON array under data.
GET /v2/videos/{uid} returns the raw video object under data.
POST /v2/videos queues an async render. Modifications list is omitted in this subset.
PATCH /v2/videos updates uid and approved.
GET /v2/collections returns a JSON array under data.
GET /v2/collections/{uid} returns the raw collection under data.
POST /v2/collections queues a template-set render.
GET /v2/screenshots returns a JSON array under data.
GET /v2/screenshots/{uid} returns the raw screenshot under data.
POST /v2/screenshots queues a website capture.
GET /v2/fonts returns font families grouped by style under data.
EventOnly mapping of Bannerbear image_created webhooks. No HTTP handler.
EventOnly mapping of Bannerbear video_created webhooks. No HTTP handler.
EventOnly mapping of Bannerbear template_created webhooks. No HTTP handler.
EventOnly mapping of Bannerbear screenshot_created webhooks. No HTTP handler.

healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Validate the Bannerbear API key with GET /v2/auth.

account.get.title: Get account
account.get.description: Read Bannerbear account quota and current project usage.

templates.list.title: List templates
templates.list.description: List Bannerbear templates in the connected project.

templates.get.title: Get template
templates.get.description: Retrieve one Bannerbear template by UID.

templates.create.title: Create template
templates.create.description: Create a blank Bannerbear template with a name and canvas size.

templates.update.title: Update template
templates.update.description: Update Bannerbear template name, tags, or canvas size.

templates.delete.title: Delete template
templates.delete.description: Permanently delete a Bannerbear template. This cannot be undone.

images.list.title: List images
images.list.description: List generated Bannerbear images in the connected project.

images.get.title: Get image
images.get.description: Retrieve one Bannerbear image by UID.

images.create.title: Create image
images.create.description: Queue a Bannerbear image render from a template and layer modifications. Rendering is asynchronous; poll images.get or use a webhook.

videos.list.title: List videos
videos.list.description: List generated Bannerbear videos in the connected project.

videos.get.title: Get video
videos.get.description: Retrieve one Bannerbear video by UID.

videos.create.title: Create video
videos.create.description: Queue a Bannerbear video render from a video template and input media URL.

videos.update.title: Update video
videos.update.description: Approve a Bannerbear video or patch its transcription so rendering can start.

approved.description: Set true to approve and start rendering.

collections.list.title: List collections
collections.list.description: List Bannerbear collections (multi-template image sets) in the connected project.

collections.get.title: Get collection
collections.get.description: Retrieve one Bannerbear collection by UID.

collections.create.title: Create collection
collections.create.description: Queue a Bannerbear collection render against a template set.

screenshots.list.title: List screenshots
screenshots.list.description: List Bannerbear website screenshots in the connected project.

screenshots.get.title: Get screenshot
screenshots.get.description: Retrieve one Bannerbear screenshot by UID.

screenshots.create.title: Create screenshot
screenshots.create.description: Queue a Bannerbear screenshot of a public website URL.

fonts.list.title: List fonts
fonts.list.description: List valid Bannerbear font families grouped by style.

webhook.image_created.title: Image created
webhook.image_created.description: Bannerbear project webhook when an image render completes. Maps event=image_created.

webhook.video_created.title: Video created
webhook.video_created.description: Bannerbear project webhook when a video render completes. Maps event=video_created.

webhook.template_created.title: Template created
webhook.template_created.description: Bannerbear project webhook when a template is created. Maps event=template_created.

webhook.screenshot_created.title: Screenshot created
webhook.screenshot_created.description: Bannerbear project webhook when a screenshot render completes. Maps event=screenshot_created.
